blocks.label: spacr.install_cleanup.apply_optional_cleanup#1
blocks.source: Only a trusted Python context-manager factory can enable execution. The application's caller must hold its established run-registration lock and refuse active work throughout the context. This is an application-local safeguard, not proof that every other process is idle. A separate helper or saved dictionary cannot grant that authority.
blocks.context_source: Only a trusted Python context-manager factory can enable execution. This is an application-local safeguard, not proof that every other process is idle. A separate helper or saved key-value mapping cannot grant that authority.

blocks.source: Every selected snapshot is validated before mutation. Each action identity is consumed once in this process. Changed, unknown or locked detached entries remain in private staging; no recursive deletion or overwriting restoration is performed. Models, data and other protected roots cannot be selected. Supported no-follow directory descriptors are required.

blocks.label: spacr.install_cleanup.preview_optional_cleanup#1
blocks.source: Recognized cache contents are inspected only under the default spaCR home. A bounded relocation manifest may also be read from a configured spaCR home to display retained external paths. External, symlinked, unknown and protected cache contents remain unavailable. Inspection is bounded and never follows links. A trusted live application guard can enable candidates; a saved selection cannot authorize removal. This does not establish that every other application instance is idle.

blocks.label: spacr.install_cleanup.start_update_helper#12
blocks.source: A frozen macOS bundle in a user-writable location uses its verified DMG replacement adapter and retains its complete prior bundle. A protocol-marked Debian bundle uses graphical administrator authorization and a root-owned helper outside the installation. Both the replacement and rollback package require published checksums; package and unprivileged runtime verification precede relaunch. Unsupported frozen application families return an error before removing anything; no online-installer fallback is enabled for them.
